title: One-step walk decomposition
statement: Let $R$ be a binary relation on the natural numbers, and let $K,j,c,t$ be natural numbers. There is an $R$-walk of length at most $j+1$ from $c$ to $t$, with intermediate vertices less than $K$, if and only if either there is such a walk of length at most $j$ from $c$ to $t$, or there is a number $w$ such that there is such a walk of length at most $j$ from $c$ to $w$, $R(w,t)$ holds, and $t<K$.
hypotheses_covered: a binary relation $R$ on the natural numbers
